A slip: a printed strip showing the lower part of the card (the card-type or stat bar, the game-text box and the numbers beside it) with the corrected game text, and below it a black strip with the title and a white E, meant to be placed over the original card. Published by the Players Committee in its Decipher Errata sheet dated 1 January 2013.

== What changed on the image ==
[[File:Hoth-D-walkerbarrage-PC-Errata-2013-slip-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with the printed card [[Walker Barrage]] (Decipher, 1996; Decipher's [[Walker Barrage (Decipher Errata 1998)|November 1998 errata]] was published as text only): The game text changes to Decipher's errata wording, the same words as [[Walker Barrage (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's November 1998 errata]]: “If you have a piloted AT-AT present at a site, target opponent’s artillery weapon at same or adjacent exterior site. Draw destiny. Target lost if destiny +1 > forfeit. Also, one opponent’s character at same site as target (random selection) lost if destiny +1 > 6.”. The slip adds a black strip below the text box with the title “Walker Barrage” and a white italic “E”.

Lower part of the printed card (the area the slip covers, scaled to the slip's width) and the 2013 slip as cut from the sheet at 300 dpi; nothing else is edited.
